title: Audit logs of version 1 and mixed logs (SPEC-v0 sections 8, 9.4 and 14)

requires.description: An optional algorithm the case needs (SPEC-v0 sections 7.1 and 10.2): an implementation without it answers unsupported, and the case does not count for its class.

broken_at.description: seq of the first violating entry; 0 if it has no readable seq.

entries.description: Entries in file order. Deliberately unconstrained: invalid logs contain entries that violate the audit schema.

jsonl.description: The log in the exchange format (SPEC-v0 section 9.4) as one string, for cases about line separators.

entries_base64.description: Entries in file order as bytes in base64 with padding (RFC 4648 section 4), for cases about bytes (SPEC-v0 section 10.2).

jsonl_base64.description: The log in the exchange format as bytes in base64 with padding (RFC 4648 section 4), for cases about bytes (SPEC-v0 section 10.2).

keys.description: Path to a JWK Set with the public keys that may sign checkpoints of the log (SPEC-v0 section 9.5), relative to the repository root. If present, the signatures of checkpoints are verified.

log_id.description: Expected identifier of the log; only with keys.

anchored.description: For a valid log verified with keys: the seq up to which a verified checkpoint covers the log; 0 if none.

integrity_broken_at.description: seq of the first entry at which the log is not complete and unaltered (SPEC-v0 section 9.4); 0 if it has no readable seq; absent if there is none.

conformance_broken_at.description: seq of the first entry of a known audit version that breaks condition 1 (SPEC-v0 section 9.4); 0 if it has no readable seq; absent if there is none.

unknown_version_at.description: seq of the first entry of an audit version the verifier does not know (SPEC-v0 sections 9.4 and 14); absent if there is none.

checkpoint_gap_at.description: For a valid log with a checkpoint: seq of the first entry at which the writer did not keep the cadence of checkpoints (SPEC-v0 section 9.5); absent if there is none.
